comment: Forever-exclusive audit (issue #21). foreverIds = quests on the PandaBase zone map page that the pinned QuestieDB lacks. Each one is in a MAIN chain, in tools/sagas/side_zones.json, or here with a reason. Refresh the IDs with: python tools/audit_forever.py fetch. Check: python tools/audit_forever.py check.
